items.q: And when I became Master, he was my treasurer, and Lem Johnson, deacon of the blues, he was my junior warden.

ctx.x: brought a lot of musicians into (unintelligible) Number Four. So he started me off. I worked all around, and he was Master for the lodge for three years. And when I became Master, he was my treasurer, and Lem Johnson, deacon of the blues, he was my junior warden. So when I became master, he was in line, because you had to be senior warden next to master (unintelligible), and that time, oh, we had a lot -- the list of musicians, we had a lot of them on the --
This was at the time you were the master of (unintelligible)?
